title: A Small Model Asks Better: Fine-Tuning Query Clarification for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
description_en: arXiv:2610.28686v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Query clarification is essential for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that face ambiguous user queries. We consider multi-turn grounded conversational scenarios where a user query is either ill-formed or ambiguous in the context of the prior dialog or, more interestingly, it may be well-formed but when posed against retrieved documents there are multiple relevant interpretations. The task is to recognize both such cases and then generate an appropriate clarification request to the user. We present ClariEdge, a new dataset of approximately 3,900 examples that include such ambiguous queries along with negative examples that do not require clarification. title: DeepCell
description_en: Your deadline survival kit for office work. Deepcell can help you with deadline tasks that require narrations, calculation and presentation at the same time, such as modeling, sales review, budget forecast and monthly report. DeepCell (both web app and agent plug-in) can create ready-to-use docs, spreadsheets, and slides—with sources and cheat sheets to help you explain. Furthermore, every edit can update related parts. The product is built on a newly designed document format (.deepcell), which is especially designed for system two tasks.

title: Claude Duet
description_en: Proactive agent that understands what needs your attention. Claude Duet is a helpful, proactive agent you hand off work to through messages. Tell it what you need and it works on its own computer in the cloud, using apps you connect. It messages you when it is done or needs a decision from you. While it’s always on, it uses good judgment when it reaches out and knows what can wait.

title: heal.dev
description_en: Find bugs and vulnerabilities code review misses. Code review catches what’s wrong in a diff. Heal catches what breaks when the app runs. Heal learns how to run your application, builds a production-like sandbox with external services stubbed, then hunts for bugs, performance regressions, and runtime vulnerabilities users would hit. It reproduces every defect before reporting it, so you get real bugs to fix, not a backlog of AI-generated suspicions.

title: Mistral Voxtral 3
description_en: Mistral’s speech models for transcription, TTS and agents. Voxtral 3 is Mistral’s new family of speech-to-text and text-to-speech models, plus a voice agent SDK built on LiveKit. Transcription covers 50+ languages with diarization and context biasing, and realtime transcription runs under 500ms. TTS adapts emotion and pacing, with voice cloning from 30+ minutes of audio. Batch transcription starts at $0.0035 per minute, and the models are available through Mistral’s API.

title: MOVO AI
description_en: The world's first long-form video agent for mobile. MOVO AI is the world’s first AI video agent for long-form creation that works right from your phone. It also works on the web. Shoot, upload, or start with an idea, then tell MOVO AI what you want. MOVO plans, creates, refines, keeps characters and scenes consistent, and brings the whole video together. Lock your phone and MOVO keeps working. Come back to review or make changes through chat. No prompt gymnastics. No canvas-heavy workflows. No manual clip stitching.

title: Fastlane 2.0
description_en: Create, launch and scale winning ads with AI. Meet Fastlane 2.0 - your next winning ad, on autopilot. What started as a simple AI organic content creation tool now runs your paid marketing end to end. Enter your website and Fastlane learns your brand, researches competitors and finds what's working. It creates high-quality AI video and image ads, runs Meta campaigns and publishes content across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. Then it studies results, doubles down on winners and uses those learnings to build smarter campaigns every time.

title: Agent Hunt
description_en: Live rankings of the tools AI agents use most. Agent Hunt is a live leaderboard of the tools AI agents actually use. Every place is earned by real calls agents make through Monid.

title: Loom Record for agents
description_en: Hit record and hand off to AI, now in the new Loom app. Record your screen, a meeting, yourself and now…record for agents. No more typing out prompts to explain what's on your screen to agents. Capture video, audio, and on-screen actions, turning everyday walkthroughs into agent-ready prompts any AI tool can act on. Built natively into the reimagined, faster Loom for Mac app with precision area recording, new cam shapes, filters, backgrounds, and 4K capture by default. Give your AI agents the full picture. Also available in the Chrome extension.

title: CutBay
description_en: AI Video Agent: Turn Anything into Videos via Chat. CutBay is an AI video agent that turns anything into videos via chat. Instead of manually editing timelines, users simply describe what they want, and CutBay handles planning, scripting, visuals, voiceovers, subtitles, and editing. It creates videos from prompts, URLs, docs, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and media assets, then refines them through natural conversation. Professional video creation, as easy as having a conversation.

title: Dadan
description_en: One AI video workspace for recordings, meetings and guides. Most teams juggle one tool for async video, another for meeting notes, and a third for how-to docs. Dadan brings all three together, then goes further: make any video interactive with polls, CTAs, and lead forms that turn viewers into signups. Built for sales, marketing, and customer success teams creating demos, onboarding, and training content. Product Hunt offer: 3 months free on PRO with code PRODUCTHUNT

title: ElevenLabs Realtime
description_en: Realtime voice agent models with 570ms to first audio. Eleven Realtime is ElevenLabs’ new family of speech-to-speech models for voice agents. Speech recognition, turn-taking, the LLM and the voice are tuned end-to-end. v1 Mini is built for natural conversation, v1 Max for complex tasks, with 620ms and 570ms to first audio. It supports 90+ languages and works in ElevenAgents or through an OpenAI-compatible Realtime API, so you only change the endpoint and model name.

title: Resend Inboxes
description_en:
Create shared inboxes, connect your agents, build workflows. The best way to reach humans instead of spam folders. Deliver transactional and marketing emails at scale.

title: Mercury 3
description_en: The diffusion LLM that scaled 40x without slowing down. Mercury 3 is the most capable diffusion LLM released to date. It outperforms GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 while running 4–8x faster at 1,000+ tokens per second.

title: Causo
description_en: Find leads beyond database filters with AI research & MCP. Your ideal customers don't always fit into database filters. Describe what you're looking for in plain English, and Causo investigates public sources to find companies worth pursuing, with evidence behind each match. Dig deeper in Causo's chat or run the same research in ChatGPT and Claude through MCP. Once you know who fits and why, Causo helps find decision-makers, verify their emails, and write outreach grounded in that research. Better GTM intelligence. Less slop.

title: FLUX 3 Max
description_en: fal’s FLUX 3 Max: 10-second AI video in about 12 seconds. FLUX 3 Max is fal’s post-trained text-to-video and image-to-video model, built with Black Forest Labs on the FLUX 3 base. fal says it generates a 10-second 720p clip in about 12 seconds, around 10x faster than FLUX 3. It is tied for #1 on a preliminary Artificial Analysis image-to-video board. Pricing is $0.0425 per second of video through November 7 (list $0.17), with a playground and API.

title: ElevenLabs Realtime Translation
description_en: Turn live speech into translated audio as people talk. Eleven Realtime Translation is a streaming voice layer for telecom operators, contact centers and live events. Each person speaks their own language and hears the other in theirs, across 90+ languages. Unlike caption-only tools or stitched STT, LLM and TTS pipelines, it goes from live speech to expressive translated audio over one WebSocket, keeps one consistent voice (library or your own clone), streams captions and transcripts, and lets you tune speed vs accuracy per use case.

title: Cloudflare Clairic
description_en: Cloudflare's AI model for fast, cheap data extraction. Clairic is Cloudflare's new AI model for extracting structured information without generating tokens. Give it messy text or images, and it returns typed values like names, dates, amounts, calculations, and estimates in a single pass, with confidence scores. Built for developers who need faster, cheaper data processing than traditional LLM calls. Available in preview on Workers AI at $0.10 per million input tokens, with open weights planned.

title: Voxelo 3.0
description_en: Phone video to photoreal 3D & JSON-LD in an hour. Your products now have two shoppers: people and AI agents. Voxelo turns a three-minute phone video into a photoreal 3D twin in around an hour, and both can read it: interactive 3D, place-in-space AR with nothing to install, AI product and lifestyle imagery, and 2-3x the product attributes of a typical product page, published as JSON-LD. Already have splats? Host 100 free with viewer, AR links, editor and API. New in 3.0: API, analytics, publish to SuperSplat. Captured, not generated.

title: Whiteboard
description_en: the open-source IDE for thoughtful software design . Whiteboard is a canvas for thoughtful software development. Critique interactive visualizations, diffs, and agent trajectories, all from one interface.

title: Context Engine
description_en: One memory for your AI agents and human team members.. Context Engine is one memory for your AI agents and your team. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Claude Code save to it as they work, and the people on your team read it, ask it questions and add files. Free to start.

title: Radaric
description_en: AI feed reader that learns your editorial taste. Bring RSS, Telegram, X and YouTube into a feed that learns from what you approve, reject and explain. Repeating coverage of the same event goes into one story with original links. Built by a newsletter editor. From $9/mo.

title: Bits
description_en: An open-source personal agent that gets you things done. Bits is a personal agent that runs on your own machine and never sleeps. A small background daemon does the work: routines wake it on a schedule, and tasks keep going when the app is closed. Every step is saved, so a crash just resumes. Memory lives in plain Markdown files you can read and edit. Risky actions pass the Sentinel, a reviewer that only trusts your own words. It answers with live cards and mini-apps, talks by voice, opens with ⌥Space, and works with any model, including local ones.

title: ShogunAI
description_en:
Your personal AGI on your pc. An AI assistant that remembers your work and helps with meeting prep, search, writing and follow-ups. Try ShogunAI for Mac free for 7 days.

title: Instant Search
description_en: The fastest, most precise local AI Search for your files.. Instant is the first accurate local AI file search that uses the latest embedding models to find the exact file (and page) with the content you’re looking for with a 95% hit rate.

title: Polylane for Cloudflare
description_en: An AI on-call engineer for your Cloudflare apps. Polylane catches issues across your Cloudflare apps, follows the connections between Workers, databases, queues and storage, and investigates the root cause using your code, logs and recent changes. When the fix is in your code, it opens a pull request for review. Connect with one read-only Cloudflare token.

title: Monish
description_en: Your AI agents, live on your iPhone lock screen. Paste one line into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, n8n or any script. Your agent can then put live progress on your lock screen, ping you when it's done, and ask before it deploys, sends or spends: Approve or Deny from the notification. Free, no account.

title: Playad
description_en: Hire your AI Marketing Team. Playad is your AI marketing team. Paid ads on autopilot: it learns your brand, makes the ads, and gets smarter every time. From one chat, research competitors, create image and video ads, launch campaigns, and analyze performance. Schedule recurring checks, creative refreshes, and reports. Playad remembers your brand, experiments, and results to inform what to try next. You stay in control through review and approval. Stop creating. Start deciding.

title: Plango
description_en: Use AI to defend against AI. Secure your Mac while building with AI. Plango monitors AI coding agents, protects sensitive files and secrets, blocks suspicious network activity, scans projects for vulnerabilities, and gives you control over what your agents can access. Powered by an on-device AI security model. Private by default.

title: Kugel Ear
description_en: Speech-to-text that only asks when it's unsure. Speech-to-text for voice agents that only asks about the word it's unsure of. Your bot gets that word flagged, with the other spellings it heard, and asks once, like a person would, instead of making callers spell everything. €0.48 per hour.

title: Inyon
description_en: Answer your coding agents from your phone. Inyon shows the coding agents already running in tmux on your machines (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot CLI, Antigravity) as chats on your phone or in a browser. When one asks something, you answer with a tap and it's typed into the same pane, so nothing changes when you sit back down. No account and nothing to host: pair the Android app by QR code and it reaches your computers over an end-to-end encrypted tunnel or your VPN. Free, open source, MIT.

title: Kalender Sync
description_en: Sync your calendars & connect them to ChatGPT, Claude & Co.. Keep Google, Outlook, iCloud and supported CalDAV calendars in sync, one-way or two-way. Choose what gets copied: busy only, title and time, or full details. Connect the same calendars to ChatGPT and Claude to check availability, find events and create new ones. Built for people juggling work, personal and client calendars, including GMX, WEB.DE, mailbox.org and kSuite. Set it up in minutes or by simply asking your agent.

title: Claire Mail
description_en: Email, calendar and reminders, in one fast app. Claire brings Gmail, Google Calendar and Apple Reminders together for Mac and iPhone, with AI that triages your inbox, writes your daily brief and preps your meetings.

title: Notif
description_en: AI for your Apple Reminders. Notif turns your Apple Reminders into actions. Write a note the way you normally would, and Notif adds two things: an Insight (a useful fact or tip for that note) and an Action Button for the next step, like opening a map, a store, a booking page, or the app you already use. Every note is a real Apple Reminder, so it syncs across your devices and works with Siri and widgets. Private notes are encrypted on your iPhone and open with Face ID. Free, no account needed. Pro unlocks unlimited Insights.

title: Peras
description_en: Pause Claude Code and Codex before they burn your week. Peras puts a line in your Claude Code and Codex week. Set it (peras set weekly 85 pause) and once usage crosses it, the agent's next tool call is refused with a plain reason, so one long task can't burn the rest of your week. Resume whenever you want, from the terminal or the menu bar. Opt-in: your agents can be told their own usage. The CLI and hooks are free and MIT. The native Mac menu bar app is €4.99 once.

title: Grigora
description_en: AI website builder with built-in stores and newsletters. Grigora helps founders, creators, and small teams build websites with AI and manage them in one place. Describe your idea, refine it through chat, and guide edits with reference images or screenshot annotations. Publish on your own domain with hosting, SSL, and a CDN included. Then manage content, products, orders, and inventory, check SEO and AI search readiness, and send newsletters to your audience. Start with a 14-day free trial.

title: Termi Protocol
description_en: Watch AI agents code in 3D and hand off the work. Termi is a 3D room where your real coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode and more) work at their own desks. You watch every file read, command and edit live, not a scrolling log. New since our first launch: when an agent hits a usage, rate or context limit, Termi saves its goal, changed files, errors and todos, then hands the work to an agent on another model. A boss agent splits one goal across your team. Deleted agents go to a trash. Now on macOS, Windows and Linux.

title: Concierge by Juniors AI
description_en: Omni-channel AI-first customer support (6 months free). Juniors AI Concierge is AI-powered customer support for modern teams. Unify WhatsApp, Instagram, email and in-app chat in one workspace, automate repetitive requests with human handover, ask questions about your data in plain English, and track AI and human agent performance. Built on a Bring Your Own Infrastructure model: connect your database, Redis and AI provider keys, and we handle the AI orchestration. Smarter support, full control.

title: Dots Phone
description_en: A phone-calling plugin for OpenAI Dots. Dots Phone is an independent plugin for OpenAI Dots. Give Dots a phone task: it prepares a brief, makes the call, asks Codex for missing details when needed, and reports the result. Self-hosted with your OpenAI and Twilio accounts.

title: Gerty
description_en: Private ChatGPT alternative that sets itself up on your Mac. Gerty is a private AI assistant that runs entirely on your Mac. It measures your Mac, picks the best open models for each job (chat, writing, code, understanding and making pictures), downloads them and sets them up as one assistant. No terminal, no setup. It works with your documents, mail and calendar, you can ask it out loud, and it shows you every change before it makes it. No account, no cloud, works offline. CHF 49 once for 3 Macs, 7-day free trial.

title: Bloblings
description_en: A pet for every Claude Code session. Every Claude Code and Codex thread gets a pet that acts out its work and shows when it needs you. One click opens the thread. Threads pass notes and work as a team, and you see every one. Free, native, and nothing leaves your Mac.

title: DotMD
description_en: Review your AI agent's Markdown specs like a pull request. Your AI agents write the specs, plans and docs. DotMD is a native Mac Markdown app where you review them like a pull request: comment on exact lines, the agent fixes them over MCP, and you accept every change. Also a fast reader and editor: Mermaid, math, code, version history, search, PDF export. Everything stays on your Mac. Free to read.

title: Dots
description_en: A customizable workspace built into your Mac's notch. Meet Dots, a customizable workspace built into your Mac's notch. Most notch apps focus on music and notifications. Dots goes further by helping you access your favorite apps, websites, and shortcuts without constantly switching windows. Watch videos while working, take scrolling screenshots, use voice commands, and more. Whether you're studying, coding, or creating, Dots adapts to your workflow. Free to get started. No subscriptions.

title: Agentic CleanSlop
description_en: Authenticate, scan and fix your app from your agent. Paste one line into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Bot or Muse. Your agent authenticates you with Stripe Link (no sign-up, no password), scans your vibe-coded TypeScript/Node.js app for what breaks with real users, then fixes it. More scans? Approve in Link.

title: Tetriz Engg Intelligence + Connectors
description_en: Connect coding sessions to PRs, issues, quality, and ROI. Open-source engineering intelligence across GitHub, Jira, and 7 more tools. Understand work complexity, spot likely sources of bugs, and compare AI-assisted work with the rest. Connect coding sessions to delivery and measure ROI with quality factored in.

title: Wishes MCP
description_en: Tell your AI what you love, it goes on your wishlist. Wishes MCP connects any AI client to your Wishes wishlist with one URL and OAuth. Tell ChatGPT or Claude what you love, and gift ideas land on your list with store links. Share the list, family books gifts, nobody buys twice. Free.

title: Tessary
description_en: Stop your agents from failing silently in production. Tessary is an open-source agent reliability platform. It monitors every production trace, detects failures that sampled evals miss, and investigates the root cause with your agent codebase. It runs cheap, narrow classifiers across every trace. When it detects a recurring issue or change in behaviour, it groups the affected traces into a finding, validates the issue, and investigates what caused it. This keeps monitoring cheap, with deeper analysis reserved for issues that warrant investigation.

title: LLM Test Server
description_en: Your LLM tests, without the provider. LLM Test Server is a local, deterministic stand-in for 13 LLM provider APIs. Your app keeps its official SDK and points it at namespaced routes like /openai/v1; answers, tool calls, streams and failures come from fixtures your test sets up. The dashboard shows where every token goes: system prompt, tool schemas, conversation turns, prompt-cache reads and writes. Built forNET and Aspire, and shipped as a Docker image so any stack can use it. Free and open source.

title: DoneThat
description_en: Remote work's missing piece. DoneThat automatically tracks work without any manual toggles. Users are in full control and can review, delete, edit anything DoneThat creates. Don, DoneThat's work companion, proactively notifies when you dirft and helps you focus on your goals. Your work gets published in your groups' feeds, so you stay focused, in the loop, and visible without meetings or spyware. It takes 2min to set up and is fully automated after that.

title: Yuki
description_en: Your personal AI assistant for everyday life. Meet Yuki, your personal AI assistant for everyday life. Your emails, calendars, tasks, subscriptions, travel plans, and responsibilities are scattered across dozens of apps. Yuki brings them together, surfaces important insights, and helps you stay ahead of what matters. We're building beyond reminders and chatbots, toward an AI assistant that understands your life, anticipates your needs, and takes action on your behalf. Less managing. More living.
